title: Add doNotPerformUpgrade setting and enhance upgrade warning messages
summary: AL-Go pipeline now supports skipping the upgrade phase with a new doNotPerformUpgrade setting while continuing to publish and test apps. Warning messages about upgrade testing have also been improved.
key_points: New doNotPerformUpgrade boolean setting allows users to bypass the upgrade phase during pipeline execution
Setting is integrated into configuration schema and pipeline parameter list
Feature is documented in release notes and settings documentation
Warning messages clarified to indicate when missing previous release apps disables AppSourceCop breaking change checks
Supports use cases where upgrade testing is not needed
quote: allowing users to bypass the upgrade phase during pipeline execution
